lines: Switching to a tab you have been on shows it at once, and every place has the same sidebar with Hide and Expand.
Connect a service from one card in the chat: Fathom, Stripe, Resend, HubSpot, Mailgun, Dropbox Sign, Zoom and Twilio.
Automations: Allow or Deny what waits for you, wait for an event, pick files and records by name, and a menu on every row.
Wide tables keep their first column in view, and a Markdown table's cells, rows and columns can be edited.
Open in New Tab on every place's rows, and Drive and OneDrive files open in Vyre's own viewers with edits sent back.
Getting started's How you work is a talk with the Assistant. Delete an agent for good. A goal says why a check-in could not run.
